activation_gates: Keep both current and predecessor assisted routes disabled and keep the CRM button and Forms Prefill Webhook unbound.

The contained source has no token, Form URL, CRM Connection, Data Store adapter, session, Catalyst SDK, or outbound-network capability; the Advanced I/O adapter still performs header and response I/O.
Any future assisted flow requires a new reviewed transport, controller, credential, data, request, response, rollback, and readback contract; this manifest cannot authorize activation.
Read back every existing Retell-project Advanced I/O endpoint and Security Rule before enabling API Gateway.
Deploy and read back the exact containment source revision and its reduced variable map before any live cleanup.
Preserve predecessor source, routes, variables, Connections, and tables as disabled evidence until separately approved cleanup readback succeeds.
Reject any optional-auth or wildcard route.

rollback.containment_target: both current and predecessor Form 1 assisted routes inactive with both callers unbound
rollback.first: unbind the CRM button and Forms Prefill Webhook if either binding is observed
rollback.then: disable both current and predecessor Form 1 assisted routes
rollback.prohibited: do not restore any pre-containment Form 1 route, caller binding, variable map, Connection grant, or artifact revision
